homepage.title: We're Getting Married!
homepage.message: We're so excited to celebrate our wedding with our favourite people and can't wait to share our special day with you.
homepage.subtitle: 12 June 2027 • Froginwell Vineyard

story.title: How It All Began
story.content: From our first meeting to this exciting new chapter, we've been incredibly lucky to share so many wonderful memories together. We've laughed, travelled, celebrated milestones, supported one another through life's adventures and built a life that we love. Now we're looking forward to bringing together all the people who mean so much to us as we begin married life. Thank you for being part of our journey. We can't wait to celebrate with you.

journey.description: We made a house a home.

bbq.title: Join Us for a Relaxed BBQ
bbq.description: For those staying locally, we'd love for you to join us for a relaxed BBQ the day after the wedding. We'll be gathering to enjoy good food, good company and the chance to relive the highlights from the day before. Further details will be shared closer to the wedding.

venue.name: Froginwell Vineyard
venue.description: Nestled in the beautiful Devon countryside, Froginwell Vineyard provides the perfect backdrop for our wedding celebration. Surrounded by a vineyard, apple orchard, and 4 acres of wildflower meadow, it immediately felt like the perfect place for us to celebrate our special day.
venue.arrival: Please aim to arrive at 1:00pm and allow extra time when travelling as country roads can be busy, especially during summer weekends.

travel.parking: Free on-site parking is available for all guests. Free overnight parking is available in the front field.
travel.accessibleParking: Accessible parking spaces are available close to the venue.
travel.camping: Guests staying onsite can walk directly to the venue from the camping fields.
travel.rail: The nearest mainline station is Exeter St Davids.
travel.taxi: We recommend pre-booking taxis where possible, especially for the return journey after the evening reception.
travel.road: Froginwell Vineyard is easily accessible by car and located a short drive from Exeter.

campingcaravanning.title: Camping & Caravanning at Froginwell Vineyard
campingcaravanning.description: Stay right in the heart of the celebrations with exclusive camping and caravanning facilities available for our wedding guests.
campingcaravanning.notes: Additional nights may be available by arrangement with the venue, subject to availability and the Froginwell events calendar.

accommodation.name: The Devon Hotel
accommodation.description: A comfortable hotel located within easy reach of Froginwell Vineyard.

accommodation.name: The Cridford Inn
accommodation.description: A charming countryside inn with character and a warm welcome.

accommodation.name: Hunters Moon Hotel
accommodation.description: Comfortable accommodation with convenient access to the venue and surrounding area.

faq.question: What is the dress code?
faq.answer: Formal attire. We'd love everyone to dress up and celebrate with us.

faq.question: How far is the venue from Exeter?
faq.answer: Froginwell Vineyard is a short drive from Exeter and nearby accommodation options.

faq.question: Can I bring children?
faq.answer: Please refer to your invitation. Unfortunately, we're unable to accommodate guests beyond those named.

faq.question: What if I have dietary requirements?
faq.answer: Please include any dietary requirements when completing your RSVP.

faq.question: Is there parking available?
faq.answer: Yes. Complimentary on-site parking is available.

faq.question: Can I leave my car overnight?
faq.answer: Yes, overnight parking is allowed in the front field.

faq.question: Can I camp at the venue?
faq.answer: Yes. Exclusive camping and caravanning facilities will be available for our wedding guests. Details can be found in the Accommodation section.

faq.question: Do I need to book camping / caravanning separately?
faq.answer: Please submit a request via our dedicated Camping & Caravanning request form, and we will handle the booking with Froginwell Vineyard directly. Please note that caravanning spots are limtied and allocated on a first come, first served basis.

faq.question: What happens if it rains?
faq.answer: The venue has excellent indoor facilities, so the celebrations will continue whatever the weather.

faq.question: What time does the reception finish?
faq.answer: The reception will offically finish at midnight, but live music will stop at 11pm.

faq.question: Can I take photographs during the ceremony?
faq.answer: We do kindly ask that people don't take photos during the ceremony, as we have hired a professional photographer. All photos will be made available via this website after the wedding. We encourage you to take photos at all other times!

faq.question: Do I need to RSVP for the BBQ?
faq.answer: Yes please. You'll find a question about the BBQ within the RSVP form.

photoSharing.title: Photo Sharing
photoSharing.description: We'll share details of how to upload and view photos after the wedding.

footer.line: Good wine • Good company • Great memories to come
